notes: Extended the v1.50.1 plate-alias fix to the rest of the vehicle-document surfaces: the 7-slot document-type grid shown at the very bottom of the vehicle dashboard (estmara/work card/driver card/insurance/inspection/violation/other), the field-level document link on the vehicle info grid (e.g. clicking the insurance field opens its scanned document), the copy-summary text, and the Excel export — all four previously matched documents to a vehicle by strict plate equality and would miss any document saved under an old, now-merged plate number. All four now resolve through the vehicle's current plate and its previous_plate_numbers aliases, so every document tied to a vehicle (by plate history) shows up consistently everywhere in the dashboard. Added a 5th correctness test verifying the document-type grid shows documents from both the current and a merged old plate, and that the field-to-document link resolves an old-plate document correctly.
